claim: for every finite ordinary forest F and natural r>=1, |V(F)|=2r+4 and x(F)<r imply Delta_r(F)<=0. Consequently, for every finite ordinary tree T, leaf v, its unique neighbor s of degree two and other neighbor g, with A=T-N_T[v], H=A-g, U=T-(N_T[v] union N_T[g]), p=x(T)+1, Gamma=Delta_p(A)+Delta_(p-1)(H)<0, 2p-3<|U|, x(U)<p-2, and |U|=2p, one has Delta_(p-2)(U)<=0. Every count is an actual independent-set cardinality of that same U. This is an ordinary graph theorem, with no RTree transport.
